item.title: [Fri, Oct 30] YOUNG FRANKENSTEIN – THE MUSICAL (a TMHS & Telluride Theatre Co-Production)
item.description: 🎫 KOTO 📍 Michael D. Palm Theater, Telluride It's okay to LAUGH during spooky season… we invite you to join us for Mel Brooks' classic comedy: YOUNG FRANKENSTEIN – THE MUSICAL! Based on the film starring Gene Wilder, this musical pokes fun at Mary Shelly's "Frankenstein," along with other classic monster movies. This production is performed and designed by our very own students at Telluride Middle-High School, under the mentorship of Telluride Theatre and the R-1 School District. Grandson of the infamous Victor Frankenstein, Frederick Frankenstein (pronounced "Fronk-en-steen") inherits his family's estate in Transylvania. With the help of a hunchbacked sidekick, Igor, and a yodeling lab assistant, Inga, Frederick finds himself in the mad scientist shoes of his ancestors. "It's alive!" he exclaims as he brings to life a creature to rival his grandfather's. Eventually, of course, the monster escapes, and hilarity ensues. Have a laugh this Halloween & support our local students. Costumes encouraged! …

item.title: [Fri, Oct 30] Up-Off Gymnastics, Dance, and Spanish
item.description: 🎫 KOTO 📍 Lone Cone Library Norwood We are a MOBILE family business offering non-competitive Gymnastics, Preschool Spanish, & Dance classes to the San Miguel County area. Tia Uphoff was a competitive gymnast and an instructor for 20+ years, helping children develop balance, flexibility, strength and proper tumbling techniques while using positive reinforcement and encouragement for success. Infant to Age 5 — Padres & Pequenos Class – $10.00 per class This class invites adults & kids to participate in Educational songs, in English & Spanish, with intro to gymnastics. Sign up at any time and get started weekly. Fridays — 11:15-11:40 am @ Lone Cone Library Norwood K to 3rd Grade week Session 8 Week Winter Session $150 for the 8 sessions. Thursdays – 430-530 pm @ Lone Cone Library Norwood For more information and to register: Contact Tia @ liv2danz247@gmail.com or find us on Facebook!

item.description:

item.title: ⚡ [Meeting] Ecology Commission - Nov 04 2026 — 2026-11-04
item.description:
Town of Telluride • 2026-11-04
The Ecology Commission meets to finalize its 2027 workplan and, more consequentially, to discuss a draft ordinance that would phase out combustion-powered lawn and garden equipment within town limits. The proposed ordinance — a new Article 10 added to Chapter 7 of the Municipal Code — would ban gas-powered leaf blowers by 2028 and all other covered equipment by 2030. The recitals cite the box canyon's particular sensitivity to noise (90–110 decibels, amplified by the terrain) and air quality impacts. Colorado's HB23-1161 already provides a 30% point-of-sale discount on electric replacements, and the San Miguel Power Association offers additional rebates up to 25%, potentially offsetting roughly half the replacement cost. Exceptions are included for pre-adoption dual-use enclosed-cab tractors. The commission also votes to formally adopt its 2027 workplan, which carries forward ongoing threads: the Climate Action Plan update, bear safety programming, Trash Bash, Green Grants, and landscaping ordinance advocacy.
⚡ Why it matters: Draft ordinance could ban gas-powered yard equipment in town by 2028–2030.

item.description:

Join us for a fun and informative family workshop focused on helping your child build healthy habits! Guest speakers from Skippy Dental and Amy Erickson from San Miguel Ouray Public Health will share helpful tips on children’s dental health and nutrition. Families will also receive handouts with healthy lunch and snack ideas to take home and try with their little ones. Come learn, connect, and discover simple ways to support your child’s health and well-being! item.title: ⚡ [Meeting] Design Review Board — 2026-11-05
item.description:
Mountain Village • 2026-11-05
The November 5 Design Review Board agenda is made up entirely of single-family residence items — an easement encroachment work session at 120 Vischer Dr., an easement encroachment quasi-judicial review at 112 Stevens Dr., and three linked items for a new home at Lot 98 on Mountain Village Blvd. (height variance, initial architecture review, and vested property rights, the latter two going to Town Council as recommendations). Nothing of broad public consequence is on the agenda.
⚡ Why it matters: Quasi-judicial easement review and height variance vote for Mountain Village properties.
